description: Frozen transformation SQL used for the 2026-09-16 offline exploration, before Gold simplification.

gold.dim_drivers:
SELECT driver_id, driver_name, full_name, nationality_country_id, date_of_birth,
       2026014000 AS _release_seq
FROM silver.drivers
gold.dim_constructors:
SELECT constructor_id, constructor_name, country_id, 2026014000 AS _release_seq
FROM silver.constructors
gold.dim_races:
SELECT r.race_id, r.season, r.round, r.race_date, r.race_name,
       r.grand_prix_id, r.circuit_id, c.circuit_name, c.country_id, c.circuit_type,
       2026014000 AS _release_seq
FROM silver.races r
JOIN silver.circuits c ON r.circuit_id = c.circuit_id
gold.source_driver_standings:
SELECT season, driver_id, standing, standing_status, points, championship_won,
       2026014000 AS _release_seq
FROM silver.driver_standings
gold.source_constructor_standings:
SELECT season, constructor_id, entry_category, standing, standing_status, points,
       championship_won, 2026014000 AS _release_seq
FROM silver.constructor_standings
gold.fact_session_results:
WITH sessions AS (
    SELECT *, 'RACE' AS session_type FROM silver.race_results
    UNION ALL
    SELECT *, 'SPRINT' AS session_type FROM silver.sprint_results
)
SELECT race_id, season, round, session_type, driver_id, constructor_id, car_number,
       grid_position, grid_status, finish_position, finish_status,
       COALESCE(points, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS points,
       completed_laps, retirement_reason,
       COALESCE(session_type = 'RACE' AND finish_position = 1, FALSE) AS is_race_win,
       COALESCE(session_type = 'RACE' AND finish_position BETWEEN 1 AND 3, FALSE) AS is_race_podium,
       COALESCE(points > 0, FALSE) AS has_points,
       CASE WHEN grid_position > 0 AND finish_position > 0 AND retirement_reason IS NULL
            THEN grid_position - finish_position END AS positions_gained,
       2026014000 AS _release_seq
FROM sessions

analytics.driver_season:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW analytics.v_driver_season AS
WITH totals AS (
    SELECT _release_seq, season, driver_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN session_type = 'RACE' THEN points ELSE 0 END) AS race_points,
           SUM(CASE WHEN session_type = 'SPRINT' THEN points ELSE 0 END) AS sprint_points,
           SUM(points) AS calculated_points,
           SUM(CASE WHEN session_type = 'RACE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS race_entries,
           SUM(CASE WHEN is_race_win THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS race_wins,
           SUM(CASE WHEN is_race_podium THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS race_podiums
    FROM gold.fact_session_results
    GROUP BY _release_seq, season, driver_id
)
SELECT s._release_seq, s.season, s.driver_id, d.driver_name,
       s.standing AS source_position, s.standing_status,
       s.points AS source_points, s.championship_won,
       COALESCE(t.calculated_points, 0) AS calculated_points,
       COALESCE(t.calculated_points, 0) - s.points AS points_difference,
       COALESCE(t.race_points, 0) AS race_points,
       COALESCE(t.sprint_points, 0) AS sprint_points,
       COALESCE(t.race_entries, 0) AS race_entries,
       COALESCE(t.race_wins, 0) AS race_wins,
       COALESCE(t.race_podiums, 0) AS race_podiums
FROM gold.source_driver_standings s
JOIN gold.dim_drivers d
  ON s._release_seq = d._release_seq AND s.driver_id = d.driver_id
LEFT JOIN totals t
  ON s._release_seq = t._release_seq AND s.season = t.season AND s.driver_id = t.driver_id
WHERE s._release_seq = (SELECT MAX(release_seq) FROM ops.published_releases)
analytics.constructor_season:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW analytics.v_constructor_season AS
WITH totals AS (
    SELECT _release_seq, season, constructor_id, SUM(points) AS calculated_points,
           COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN session_type = 'RACE' THEN race_id END) AS race_weekends,
           SUM(CASE WHEN session_type = 'RACE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS race_car_entries,
           SUM(CASE WHEN is_race_win THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS race_wins,
           SUM(CASE WHEN is_race_podium THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS race_podiums
    FROM gold.fact_session_results
    GROUP BY _release_seq, season, constructor_id
)
SELECT s._release_seq, s.season, s.constructor_id, d.constructor_name,
       s.entry_category, s.standing AS source_position, s.standing_status,
       s.points AS source_points, s.championship_won,
       COALESCE(t.calculated_points, 0) AS calculated_points,
       COALESCE(t.calculated_points, 0) - s.points AS points_difference,
       COALESCE(t.race_weekends, 0) AS race_weekends,
       COALESCE(t.race_car_entries, 0) AS race_car_entries,
       COALESCE(t.race_wins, 0) AS race_wins,
       COALESCE(t.race_podiums, 0) AS race_podiums
FROM gold.source_constructor_standings s
JOIN gold.dim_constructors d
  ON s._release_seq = d._release_seq AND s.constructor_id = d.constructor_id
LEFT JOIN totals t
  ON s._release_seq = t._release_seq AND s.season = t.season AND s.constructor_id = t.constructor_id
WHERE s.entry_category = 'RANKED'
  AND s._release_seq = (SELECT MAX(release_seq) FROM ops.published_releases)
analytics.race_performance:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW analytics.v_race_performance AS
SELECT f._release_seq, f.season, f.round, f.race_id, r.race_name, r.race_date,
       r.circuit_name, r.country_id, r.circuit_type,
       f.session_type, f.driver_id, d.driver_name, f.constructor_id, c.constructor_name,
       f.car_number, f.grid_position, f.grid_status, f.finish_position, f.finish_status,
       f.points, f.completed_laps, f.retirement_reason, f.positions_gained,
       f.is_race_win, f.is_race_podium, f.has_points
FROM gold.fact_session_results f
JOIN gold.dim_races r ON f._release_seq = r._release_seq AND f.race_id = r.race_id
JOIN gold.dim_drivers d ON f._release_seq = d._release_seq AND f.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOIN gold.dim_constructors c ON f._release_seq = c._release_seq AND f.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
WHERE f._release_seq = (SELECT MAX(release_seq) FROM ops.published_releases)
analytics.season_progression:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW analytics.v_season_progression AS
WITH weekend_points AS (
    SELECT _release_seq, season, round, race_id, driver_id,
           SUM(points) AS weekend_points
    FROM gold.fact_session_results
    GROUP BY _release_seq, season, round, race_id, driver_id
)
SELECT w._release_seq, w.season, w.round, w.race_id, r.race_date,
       w.driver_id, d.driver_name, w.weekend_points,
       SUM(w.weekend_points) OVER (
           PARTITION BY w._release_seq, w.season, w.driver_id
           ORDER BY w.round ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
       ) AS cumulative_calculated_points
FROM weekend_points w
JOIN gold.dim_drivers d ON w._release_seq = d._release_seq AND w.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOIN gold.dim_races r ON w._release_seq = r._release_seq AND w.race_id = r.race_id
WHERE w._release_seq = (SELECT MAX(release_seq) FROM ops.published_releases)
